To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Novel inhaler technique reminder-labels improve the long-term retention of correct inhalation technique skills with dry-powder inhalers; 2) Inhaler technique labels are an effective, simple and scalable intervention to extend the benefit from inhaler training; 3) Inhaler technique errors represent an important target for intervention, which may have a significant effect on asthma control and quality of life.

(i) reminder labels on inhalers help to maintain correct inhaler technique, (ii) this leads to better asthma symptom control, and (iii) the use of reminder labels on inhaler devices is a simple, cheap, and scalable intervention that can help to improve asthma control and reduce the burden on health care systems.

(1) novel labels on dry powder inhalers improve the retention of correct technique, (2) the effect is greater with Accuhaler than with Turbuhaler, (3) the effect is not seen with metered dose inhalers, and (4) the effect on symptom control is not significant but active patients used significantly less reliever medication.
